Only do this if you know why %1$s changed its key, for example because its operator announced it. If someone else is answering in its place, your banknotes there and anything you send can be lost.

The app forgets it, its signing key and whether you trust it. Banknotes and history stay. If you add it again later, it\'s like the first time: the key it shows then is the one the app remembers.
